responsibility: Defines the C++ front end’s language hook table and the small set of hook implementations unique to C++ beyond the shared C++/ObjC++ layer. This file connects the front end to GCC-wide services such as DWARF naming, record classification, exception personality, template argument folding for debug info, enum underlying-type queries, OpenMP decl-init access, preprocessing hooks for modules, SARIF language tagging, and C++ selftests.
